Name: Vaughan's Lounge
Notes: Legendary Thursday night spot — Corey Henry & The Treme Funktet

Name: New Orleans Fairgrounds
Notes: Home of Jazz Fest. Large outdoor festival grounds and race course. 15 stages during Jazz Fest. Cashless event.

Name: Louis Armstrong Park
Address: 701 N. Rampart Street, New Orleans, LA 70116
Notes: Home of Congo Square. Major outdoor festival grounds in Tremé. Site of Congo Square Rhythms Festival and other Jazz Heritage Foundation events.

Name: UNO Lakefront Arena Festival Grounds
Notes: Outdoor festival grounds adjacent to UNO Lakefront Arena on Lake Pontchartrain. Home of Hogs for the Cause.

Name: Goldring Woldenberg Riverfront Park
Notes: Riverfront park along the Mississippi. New expanded stage location for French Quarter Festival 2026 — home of the Jack Daniel's Stage.

Name: Canal Place Cinema
Notes: Cinema and event space in the Canal Place shopping center. Hosts the Overlook Film Festival.

Name: Music Box Village
Address: 4557 N Rampart St, New Orleans, LA 70117
Notes: Unique outdoor venue featuring interactive musical architecture. Home of Electric Spring Festival. Also hosts regular events and rentals.

Name: New Orleans Jazz Museum
Notes: State museum dedicated to jazz history. Home of Danny Barker Festival. Also hosts FQFest programming (Loyola Esplanade in the Shade Stage and Songwriter Stage).

Name: New Orleans Lakefront — Lakeshore Drive
Notes: Open lakefront grounds along Lake Pontchartrain. Home of Brews, Boils & Bubbles. Enter via Leon C. Simon under Seabrook Bridge — no entry from Franklin Ave.

Name: Chalmette Memorial Park
Address: 101 W. St. Bernard Hwy, Chalmette, LA 70043
Notes: Outdoor festival grounds in downtown Chalmette. Home of the Louisiana Crawfish Festival. About 20 min east of New Orleans in St. Bernard Parish.

Name: The Howlin' Wolf
Address: 907 S. Peters Street, New Orleans, LA 70130
Notes: CBD music venue. Hosts Fest by Nite shows during Jazz Fest season including Help on the Way supergroup.

Name: Tipitina's
Notes: Legendary New Orleans music venue founded in 1977. Home of Shorty Fest, Daze Between Band, and countless iconic shows. Wheelchair accessible. Free parking nearby.

Name: The Joy Theater
Notes: Mid-sized concert hall on Canal Street. Regular Fest by Nite venue during Jazz Fest season.

Name: The Broadside
Address: 600 N. Broad Street, New Orleans, LA 70119
Notes: Mid-City indoor/outdoor music venue. Home of NOLA Crawfish Fest during Jazz Fest daze between week.

Name: Toulouse Theatre
Notes: Intimate venue in the French Quarter. Hosts Fest by Nite late shows and daze between programming during Jazz Fest season.

Name: d.b.a.
Notes: Live music club on Frenchmen Street since 2000. No cover most nights. Vast beer, wine & spirits selection. Friday open until 3am, Saturday from 2pm. Home of Tuba Skinny's regular Saturday sets.

Name: Gasa Gasa
Notes: Intimate indie/alternative venue on Freret Street in Uptown. Known for eclectic bookings and a welcoming atmosphere.

Name: Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro
Notes: Legendary intimate jazz venue anchoring Frenchmen Street since the 1980s. Two shows nightly (typically 7:30pm & 9:30pm). Full Creole dining available. Ages 13+ welcome for shows. Reservations recommended via OpenTable.

Name: Chickie Wah Wah
Notes: Mid-City live music club and bar. Regular venue for local and touring acts. Intimate setting with a great vibe.

Name: Freret Street
Notes: Six-block stretch of Uptown New Orleans from Napoleon to Valmont. Home of the annual Freret Street Festival (first Saturday of April). Vibrant mix of restaurants, bars, boutiques, and music venues.

Name: New Orleans Jazz Market
Address: 1436 Oretha Castle Haley Blvd, New Orleans, LA 70113
Notes: Premium intimate jazz venue in the Warehouse District. Home to serious jazz performances including Stanton Moore, Donald Harrison, and other NOLA legends. Excellent acoustics and sightlines.

Name: Saenger Theatre
Notes: Beautifully restored historic theater on Canal Street. One of NOLA's premier concert halls for major touring acts. Hosts Broadway, rock, jazz legends and more.

Name: Civic Theatre
Notes: Historic 1930 art deco theater in the CBD. ~1,500 cap. Hosts touring acts and Jazz Fest season shows.

Name: The Fillmore New Orleans
Notes: Mid-size concert hall (~2,500 cap) in the Warehouse District. AEG-operated. Hosts national touring acts and Jazz Fest season shows.

Name: Orpheum Theater
Notes: Historic 1918 beaux-arts theater beautifully restored in 2016. ~1,500 seats. Home of the Louisiana Philharmonic Orchestra and Jazz Afterdark concert series during Jazz Fest.

Name: New Orleans Pharmacy Museum
Notes: Historic 1823 apothecary turned museum. Features a beautiful outdoor courtyard used for intimate Jazz Fest season concerts. 18+, BYOB/cash bar. Small capacity — ticket availability at door not guaranteed.

Name: Republic NOLA
Address: 828 S Peters St, New Orleans, LA 70130
Notes: Warehouse District mid-size venue (~1,200 cap). Popular for Jazz Fest season shows and touring acts.
